name: uptick
description: Lists updates for Claude Code, plugins, skills-CLI skills and Homebrew in a pane, and runs one only after you confirm it.

checkCommand.title: Extra check command
checkCommand.description: Optional: a command (split like a shell, run without one) that prints JSON in the checker's schema; its items are merged into the list. Empty: only the bundled checks.

brewfile.title: Brewfile
brewfile.description: Optional: path to a Brewfile. Homebrew then lists only outdated packages named in it. Empty: every outdated package.

knownBroken.title: Known-broken list
knownBroken.description: Optional: path to a JSON file of upstream versions to hold back, shown as a note instead of an update. Empty: ~/.config/uptick/known-broken.json when it exists.

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: Comma list of the kinds to show and update: plugin, skill, brew.

hint.title: Update hint
hint.description: band: a line above the prompt when updates exist; status: a status line entry; off: nothing.

fetchOnOpen.title: Fetch on open
fetchOnOpen.description: Refresh marketplace and Homebrew metadata each time the pane opens (slow). Off: press r (Check now) in the pane.
